summary.text: Shaw Blackmon was elected to the 146th District of the Georgia House of Representatives in 2015.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Blackmon was raised in Houston County, graduated from Warner Robins High School, and earned a degree in management information systems from the University of Georgia.

The biography says he lives in Warner Robins, served on the board of the Houston County Development Authority, chaired the Robins Regional Chamber board in 2012, and is a member of the Technical College System of Georgia State Board.
